description: This file defines the SyncManager object responsible for managing synchronization preferences and authentication tokens within the application. It handles storing, clearing, and retrieving access and refresh tokens, enabling/disabling background sync via WorkManager, and checking sync status.

classes.name: SyncManager
classes.description: Singleton object that handles synchronization preferences, auth tokens, and background sync tasks.

methods.name: saveAuth
methods.description: Stores the access and refresh tokens in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: clearAuth
methods.description: Removes the stored access and refresh tokens from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: isSignedIn
methods.description: Checks if an access token exists, indicating user is signed in.

methods.name: setSyncEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables background synchronization using WorkManager.

methods.name: isSyncEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether background sync is enabled.

methods.name: accessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored access token, if any.
